description: This Java source file defines the class BlockPushNonFatalFailure, a specialized RuntimeException used in Apache Spark's network shuffle service to handle non-fatal failures during block push operations. It includes constants for different failure scenarios, methods for managing error codes, and encapsulates error response details.
